summary: Jackson County, OR lookout site on Chimney Rock: built 1955, gone after 1969. Sources disagree on tower vs ground house; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: 14 x 14 ft ground house built on a rock (1955 district report); the register and firelookout.com call it a 5-foot wooden live-in tower
facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in 1969, depending on the source; no source describes what remains

staffing.status: lookout placed June 1958; last staffing noted June 1960; not manned in summer 1963

events.note: Planned lookout reported in the Medford Mail Tribune: 14-foot-square building on a 30-foot tower, estimated cost $4,500
Built as a 14 x 14 ft ground house on a rock; district annual report gives cost $3,510.53; register dates it 1955 and calls it a 5-foot live-in tower
Lookout placed June 18, 1958, to complete the district's staffing
Maxine Gibeson of Ashland assumed the station in June 1960
One of six district lookouts not to be manned in summer 1963; the lookouts could be manned again in an emergency
Register says removed; firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page say destroyed
Registered November 24, 2010 as US 776, OR 185; nominated by Ray Kresek

corrections.why: The 30-foot figure comes from the 1952 plan; the 1955 district report describes a 14 x 14 ft ground house on a rock, and no as-built height is given in these sources

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 30-foot tower was the 1952 plan; the 1955 district report describes the built lookout as a 14 x 14 ft ground house on a rock

notes_for_editor: No source describes what remains at the site today, and no access information was found, so access is omitted. Design conflicts: the register and firelookout.com say 5-foot wooden live-in tower (the 5-foot figure is not explained), while the 1955 district report describes a 14 x 14 ft ground house on a rock; the brief's kind 'tower' rests on the register wording. The end date is disputed: removed (register) vs destroyed (firelookout.com, Forest Lookouts page), both 1969. Location: the 1952 item says between Antelope and Lake creeks; the 1955 item says Lost creek. Elevation: register 4,121 ft; the 1955 item gives a floor at about 4,112 ft. Name collision: Chandler Mountain (Chimney Rock), a Linn County lookout at firelookout.com/or/chandlermtn.html, is a different site and was excluded. No photos were added.
